# Introduction

The purpose of this page is to link some of my favourite R Shiny apps that I have developed. Most of these were developed some time ago but are likely still relevant and useful.

# Fun apps

When I was young we played a competitive card game that targets the number 24. Access my implementation by clicking the link here: [Arithmetic Game](https://seanvdm.co.za/shiny/arithmeticgame/)

It has full solution generation and card rating based on the number of solutions.

# Statistics study apps

[This app allows for easy and flexible visualisation of about 17 standard statistical densities](https://seanvdm.co.za/shiny/exploredists1/).

[This app generates endless basic hypothesis testing problems and solutions](https://seanvdm.co.za/shiny/hypothesistest/). It is ideal for students in their first course of hypothesis testing. No guarantees of perfect alignment with your course terminology, but great for training the basics. 

[This app is meant to be fun for time series course students wanting to test their visual analysis skills](https://seanvdm.co.za/shiny/timeseriespractice1/). It generates a time series with varied properties and challenges you to identify those properties visually.

[This old app is a basic quiz on practical Bayes topics](https://seanvdm.co.za/shiny/quizapp1/). It is not perfect but good for challenging yourself in a Bayes course to see which topics you are following best.
